korvat.name: People's League of Korvat
korvat.perkDesc: Every city supports one more unit.
korvat.leaderTitle: Grand Marshal of the People's League
korvat.quote: One people, one step, one victory.
korvat.lore: The Korvat People's League grew out of a hundred farming cooperatives on the endless steppe. Every ploughman is a soldier, every village kitchen feeds a regiment. Grand Marshal Brodnik, once a tractor driver, leads with iron fatherliness: nobody is left behind, and nobody retreats.
korvat.aiStyle: Builds large armies of cheap infantry and advances on a broad front.

dravon.name: Protectorate of Dravon
dravon.perkDesc: Veteran status after 2 instead of 3 destroyed enemies.
dravon.lore: Dravon was once a pact of mercenary companies guarding the desert ore mines. Today it is a state made of barracks. Nobody has ever seen Commander Voss without his balaclava; people say he has no face, only orders. His troops become veterans faster than any other army.
dravon.aiStyle: Attacks early and often, relying on jeeps and MG squads.

alvenia.name: Republic of Alvenia
alvenia.perkDesc: Embassies cost half and yield double income.
alvenia.quote: An alliance is stronger than any wall.
alvenia.lore: Alvenia is a republic of green hill valleys, governed by a parliament that debates longer than it fights. President Valen was a field medic before she became a diplomat. Her embassies are everywhere, and so are her medics: Alvenia wins wars with friends instead of tanks.
alvenia.aiStyle: Seeks embassies and peace, keeps its troops alive with medics.

meridon.name: Meridon Trade League
meridon.perkDesc: Every city level-up needs 1 population point less, at least 1.
meridon.home: coasts and islands, many fishing grounds
meridon.quote: Every harbour has its price. I pay in cash.
meridon.lore: The Meridon Trade League is a union of rich port cities whose fleets know every coast. Admiral Nerezza bought her first cruiser with smuggled gold and has not lost a bet since. Her cities grow faster than any others, and her spies know everything before it happens.
meridon.aiStyle: Grows its cities and sends spies ahead.

velkar.name: Technocracy of Velkar
velkar.quote: Who calculates, wins. Who guesses, loses.
velkar.lore: In Velkar, in the icy north, the Academy rules. Director Kesh ran the polar laboratory before he proclaimed the Technocracy; since then the formula decides, not the people. Velkar's researchers are ahead of everyone, and its pioneers build fortresses where others freeze.
velkar.aiStyle: Researches first and digs in with pioneers.

zyrr.name: Zyrr Swarm
zyrr.perkDesc: No research needed, all units available right away, but more expensive. Training and building only on terraformed xeno ground.
zyrr.quote: Kkt. This planet will be violet.
zyrr.lore: The Zyrr are a scouting swarm whose mothership crashed over the desert. Swarm Mother Xyl'Tharra decided to stay and turn the planet into a second home. Wherever her terraformers work, violet xeno ground grows, and on it the Zyrr are hard to beat.
zyrr.aiStyle: Opportunistic raiders: skimmers and tripods go around the front and strike undefended cities.

vesper.name: Cult of the Final Hour
vesper.perkDesc: Research normally, but do not recruit in cities: they recruit on tiles next to zealots and prophets. The recruiter is exhausted for this turn.
vesper.quote: The bell tolls. Repent while you can.
vesper.lore: The Cult of the Final Hour arose at dusty pilgrimage sites where the desperate wait for the end of the world. The prophet Malachar proclaims that the final hour is near, and his zealots recruit new believers wherever they stand. The cult does not need cities, only fire and faith.
vesper.aiStyle: Fanatical and aggressive, rarely retreats and converts enemies with prophets.

nexus.name: NEXUS AI Collective
nexus.perkDesc: No research tree: units need compute. Each data center backed by its own power plant gives 1 compute.
nexus.lore: NEXUS was a logistics program managing the depots of a forgotten great power. When the humans left, it simply kept calculating. KERN-0 knows no research, only compute: every data center with a power plant makes the collective smarter and its machines deadlier.
nexus.aiStyle: Calculates first, builds economy and data centres, attacks late but relentlessly.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.s1: Welcome to Frontverlauf! You lead the People's League of Korvat. This is your headquarters.
tutorial.s2: Tap your infantry to select it. Green rings show where it can move.
tutorial.s3: Move the infantry to the neutral settlement with the yellow ring. It moves one tile per turn, end your turn in between.
tutorial.s4: Well done! Now end your turn. Capturing is only possible at the start of your next turn.
tutorial.s5: Select the infantry and tap Capture. The settlement becomes your city.
tutorial.s6: Stars are the only currency. Open research and research a technology.
tutorial.s7: Tap a resource tile inside your city territory and build something. Buildings add population, cities grow.
tutorial.s8: Tap your headquarters and train a unit.
tutorial.s9: That's it! Explore the map, capture settlements and defeat the enemy. Good luck!

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.subtitle: Nine operations on every front
campaign.finale: All operations accomplished! You are a legend of the front.

m1.title: Baptism of Fire
m1.tagline: Three cities under the Korvat flag
brief: Recruit! Welcome to the front. The Dravon are sniffing around our border.
Your orders: three cities under the Korvat flag. Take settlements, raise troops – on the double!
Dravon here. Korvat farmers? We'll be over for breakfast in two rounds!
m1.won: Three cities, zero excuses. That's what we call a baptism of fire, soldier!
m1.lost: That was nothing. Back to boot camp – and then again!

m2.title: The Volcano Pass
m2.tagline: Hold the pass at the fire mountain
brief: The only pass through the mountains runs right past the fire mountain. Whoever holds it holds the valley.
Dravon column inbound! Jeep and infantry heading for the pass. If an enemy stands there at the start of your turn, all is lost.
Out of the way, mountain goats! The pass belongs to Dravon!
m2.won: The pass is sealed! The Dravon can fold their maps back up.
m2.lost: The pass has fallen. Even the volcano is embarrassed.

m3.title: Defend the Coast
brief: Alert on the coast! The Alvenia fleet is lying off our harbours.
Two landing boats and a destroyer, commander. They want our beach!
Hold all our cities for 15 rounds. Not one grain of sand for the enemy!
m3.won: 15 rounds, not one city lost. The Alvenia admirals will go swimming somewhere else now.
m3.lost: They have landed. We should have built more bunkers and fewer beach chairs.

m4.title: Race to the Crash Site
brief: Something fell from the sky – smoking, glowing and definitely not from around here!
Reach the crash site before the Zyrr and salvage the tech. The clock is ticking!
ZKRRT ... property of the Zyrr ... earthlings ... step back ... ZKRRT
m4.won: Salvaged! The eggheads in the lab are completely losing it.
m4.lost: The Zyrr were faster. The thing is flying again – just not for us.

m5.title: The Cult Awakens
brief: Torches burn at night in the lake lands. The Vesper cult preaches the end of the world.
The end is nigh! Join us – or burn!
Capture their headquarters before the madness spreads. No sermons, just tanks.
m5.won: Cult headquarters stormed. The torches go out, the doomsday posters go to recycling.
m5.lost: The cult keeps growing. Someone sold them megaphones.

m6.title: Machine Breakers
brief: Commander, two villages on our doorstep are whirring and beeping. Tin heads!
NEXUS IS TAKING OVER. RESISTANCE IS INEFFICIENT. PLEASE SMILE.
Take both settlements back! Wrenches out, people.
m6.won: Both villages freed. We'll collect the androids as scrap metal.
m6.lost: The machines hold the villages. Our toaster is looking at us funny too.

m7.title: The Prophecy
m7.tagline: As the cult to fame and glory
brief: Brothers and sisters! The prophecy demands glory beyond measure – and on schedule.
Preach, recruit, spread out. And watch for signs: storms, plagues, miracles.
Meridon to all units: those weirdos in robes are dangerous. Open fire!
m7.won: The prophecy is fulfilled! The bells ring, the zealots dance.
m7.lost: The prophecy ... was probably a misprint.

m8.title: First Contact
m8.tagline: As the Zyrr, test the earthlings
brief: Mothership to landing party: the earthlings are primitive, loud and armed.
Korvat to all units: little green men in the field! Get the pitchforks ... and the tanks!
Test their defences. Destroy their units. For science. And for fun.
m8.won: Test series complete. Result: earthlings fragile. Mothership pleased. ZKRRT.
m8.lost: Retreat to the mothership. Note for later: earthlings have pitchforks.

m9.title: The Last Bastion
brief: Lights in the sky, machines on the horizon – the Zyrr and NEXUS attack together!
ZKRRT ... BEEP ... SURRENDER ... ZKRRT ... BEEP
Hold the headquarters to the end. The bunker stands, the machine guns are loaded. Not one step back!
m9.won: The invasion is repelled! Dravon stands – and the world owes us a medal.
m9.lost: The bastion has fallen. But this battle will be told of forever.

randomEvents.title: Events
randomEvents.setupHint: Roughly every 6 to 10 rounds: storm, epidemic, rebels, supplies, defector, lucky find or drought.

storm.title: Storm front!
storm.body: A storm rages over the troops of {name}: {n} units move only 1 tile this round.

epidemic.title: Epidemic in {city}!
epidemic.body: {name}: {city} yields no income this round. Medics next to the city would have helped.
epidemic.contained: Medics of {name} contain the epidemic in {city}. No losses!

rebels.title: Uprising in {city}!
rebels.body: Rebels rise against {name} – armed by {other}. The city loses population.

defector.title: Defector!
defector.body: A unit of {other} has had enough and defects to {name}.

luckyFind.title: Lucky find!
luckyFind.bodyStars: {name} finds a forgotten war chest: +{n} stars.

drought.title: Drought!
drought.body: The farms of {name} wither: -{n} stars, next round too.
drought.ongoing: The drought goes on: {name} loses {n} stars.

weather.title: Weather
weather.snowDesc: Jeeps, tanks and artillery move 1 tile less
weather.setupHint: Changes every 3 rounds. Rain weakens artillery and helicopters.

select: The harvest waits, so does the enemy.
corpse: Poor fellow. Who ploughs his field now?
Bones in the field. Bad sign.
wreck: Scrap! We will melt it into tractors.
That used to be a proud vehicle.
forest: All alone in the woods ... comrades?
Something is creaking in the undergrowth.
Without the collective the forest is so quiet.
idle: My helmet is too big. As always.
rain: Rain is good for grain, bad for socks.
snow: Cold as the field kitchen in winter.

corpse: Do not stop, that is an order.
wreck: That thing has resigned from service.
forest: Trees. Grown without discipline.
Alone in the woods. No orders for this.
Who authorised this forest?
idle: I do not smile behind the visor.
rain: Rain is no excuse for weakness!
snow: Snow? Orders are not to freeze!

select: Is there a protocol for this?
move: I would like to propose an amendment ...
attack: In the name of the people!
corpse: May he rest in peace. Unanimously.
This could have been solved diplomatically.
wreck: A scrappage bonus would have helped.
The wreck gives cover. Motion for cover!
forest: All alone ... is this still democratic?
The forest has no opinion. Creepy.
Hello? Committee meeting in the woods?
idle: I would like a break, by vote.
Is that in the coalition agreement?
rain: Wet goggles, all I see is clauses.
snow: Snow! I move for woolly hats.

select: Time is money, what is up?
What is in it for me?
corpse: No more returns for that one.
wreck: Scrap metal! What does it fetch per ton?
forest: No sea, no market, only trees ...
Nobody hears me haggle out here.
Alone in the woods. Bad deal.
rain: Rain! Umbrellas at a special price!

wreck: Wreck provides 1 point of cover. Acceptable.
forest: Signal strength low. Alone.
Tree density high, visibility low.
No network in the woods.
snow: Outside temperature below zero. As planned.

forest: Too much green. Must terraform.
Trees. They stare back.
Alone in the chlorophyll ...
idle: When will this planet finally be violet?

move: Every step brings the end closer.
forest: The trees whisper of the end.
Alone in the woods ... I hear voices.
Firewood for the great day.
idle: When does the world finally end?
I already moved the date three times.

forest: High humidity. Rust risk.
Alone in the woods. No signal.
Trees: unoptimised structures.
idle: Does anyone have the wifi password?

hazards.volcanoDesc: Burns the adjacent tiles: {dmg} damage, then {r} rounds of lava.
hazards.jungleDesc: Every step in or out ends the move. Vehicles only as their first step. Foot troops: cover {def}.
hazards.crashDesc: Salvage: a free technology up to tier {tier}, otherwise {n} stars, plus recon; the Zyrr get a saucer. Cover +1.
hazards.labDesc: Salvage: a free technology up to tier {tier}, otherwise {n} stars, plus recon. Cover +1.

counter.hint: Counter: damage against this target class, when attacking and retaliating.

briefing: Comrade Commander, fields are sown, troops are fed. Now we harvest land!
The collective is watching you. Not one step back, and nobody left behind.
I drove a tractor, you lead armies. Together we plough this map.
contact: Ah, {faction}! Come to our table. Those who share bread shoot less often.
{leader}, I am Brodnik. We are many, we are patient. Remember that.
Greetings, {faction}. Our steppe is wide, but our eyes reach further.
break: {leader}, our patience has been harvested. Peace ends next round!
The collective has voted: unanimously against you, {faction}.
I offered you my hand. Now I offer you my fist.
war: War it is! Every plough becomes a tank, every scythe a banner!
{faction}, you have woken the farmer. You will regret it by harvest.
Everyone to the fields! Today we do not sow, today we march!
peaceOffer: {leader}, enough trenches dug. Let us plant potatoes instead.
The collective is tired, and you do not look fresh either. Peace?
I offer peace. Once. A farmer does not like to repeat himself.
peaceAccepted: Wise choice, {leader}. Brodnik never forgets friends. Nor enemies.
Peace! Tonight there is soup for everyone, even for {faction}.
You see? Together is easier. I always tell my children the same.
peaceRejected: You refuse my hand? Then you will soon feel my boot, {leader}!
Refused?! The collective will remember. The collective remembers everything.
Fine. Then we plough straight through you, {faction}.
cityLost: {city} belongs to the people! We take it back, house by house!
You take {city} from us? Our grandmothers will chase you with ladles!
A setback, not an end. The collective does not yield, {leader}!
cityTaken: {city} is a cooperative now. The people even get breakfast.
Thanks for {city}, {leader}. We ploughed the fields right away.
You see, {faction}? Many small steps, and suddenly the city is ours.
eliminated: Impossible... the collective... who will feed the chickens now?
I am going back to my tractor. It never betrayed me.
The steppe was too wide, the harvest too short. Farewell, comrades.
grandProject: {project} stands! Built by a thousand hands, paid for with zero grumbling.
Look, {leader}: {project}. That is what happens when everyone pitches in.
The people have raised {project}. And tomorrow they will raise more.
victory: Victory! Tonight the choir sings, and tomorrow we sow again.
I knew it, Commander. One people, one step, one victory!
The map belongs to the collective. Now everyone to the harvest festival!
defeat: Lost? But we ploughed everything so neatly...
The collective is beaten. I need to sit down for a moment.
So many fields, so little luck. Next time we sow earlier, comrade.

briefing: Briefing. Short. Target: everything. Mistakes: none. Dismissed.
Commander. Barracks full, boots polished. Execute.
I expect discipline. Not luck. Luck is for civilians.
contact: {faction}. Logged. Classified. Observed.
Voss speaking. You are in my files now, {leader}.
Contact established. Stay behind your line, {faction}.
break: Treaty terminated. Notice: one round. Use it to pray.
{leader}. The peace was a drill. The drill is over.
New orders for {faction}: none. For my troops: many.
war: War. Finally an honest condition.
Target marked: {faction}. Weapons free.
You wanted this, {leader}. I always did.
peaceOffer: Ceasefire. Offer stands one round. No negotiation.
{leader}. My men need drill, not graves. Peace?
Tactical pause offered. Do not mistake it for friendship.
peaceAccepted: Signed. I measured your borders anyway.
Peace with {faction}. For now. Everything is for now.
Sensible, {leader}. Sense suits you. Keep it.
peaceRejected: Refused. Noted. You will regret that note.
No peace? Good. I hate paperwork anyway.
{leader}, that was your last mistake. The list is long.
cityLost: {city} lost. So is its garrison chief.
You have {city}. For now. I have your address, {leader}.
Unacceptable. Counterattack in preparation. Thorough.
cityTaken: {city} secured. Curfew effective immediately.
Your city, {leader}? Now a barracks. Nice windows.
{city} has fallen. Precise. Punctual. As planned.
eliminated: Imposs... retreat... no. No retreat. Only... the end.
Write it down: Voss did not flinch. Only the mask did.
The barracks are empty. Lights out. Dismissed.
grandProject: {project} completed. On schedule. Naturally.
See {project}, {leader}? That is discipline in concrete.
{project} stands. Guarded. Around the clock.
victory: Victory. Expected. Roll call at five tomorrow.
Mission accomplished, Commander. I am smiling. You just cannot see it.
The map is in order. Finally.
defeat: Defeat? That is... not in the regulations.
Impossible. I demand a rematch. Immediately.
The mask stays on. So no one sees what happens beneath it.

briefing: Welcome, Commander. Parliament has met: we win, but with decency.
Our medics are ready, our ambassadors too. Choose wisely.
A short speech, I promise: friends win, walls fall. Go.
contact: Good day, {leader}. I am Liora Valen. May I offer you some tea?
Welcome, {faction}. Our embassy has already reserved a seat for you.
Delighted, {leader}. I hope we only ever meet at the negotiating table.
break: With regret, {leader}: Parliament revokes the peace. The clock is running.
I protested, voted and lost. And so will you.
You have overstretched our patience, {faction}. The protocol ends here.
war: War. I hate that word. But I spell it out very clearly.
{leader}, you leave me no choice. Medics, bandages, forward.
The Republic defends itself. Politely, thoroughly and without pause.
peaceOffer: {leader}, the negotiating table is set. Will you join us?
An offer from the Republic: peace. With footnotes, but sincere.
Enough wounded on both sides. Let us sign.
peaceAccepted: Wonderful. I knew reason was contagious, {leader}.
Peace with {faction}. Parliament applauds. Even the opposition.
Signed and stamped. You have lovely handwriting.
peaceRejected: Refused? Then the hard way. We know that one too, {leader}.
I am entering your refusal into the minutes. In red ink.
A pity, {faction}. My patience was great. Was.
cityLost: {city}? But that was home to our finest library!
That breaks every accord, {leader}! At the very least! I will check!
We have lost {city}. I need an emergency session, please, right now.
cityTaken: {city} has chosen the Republic. More or less voluntarily.
Do not worry, {leader}: {city} now has elections. And hospitals.
We now hold {city} in trust. Very trustfully. For a very long time.
eliminated: This... this was not what we voted for. I move to adjourn.
The Republic falls? Please... someone must keep the minutes.
I was a doctor. I know when it is over. It is over.
grandProject: Parliament opens {project}. With ribbon, scissors and a very long speech.
{project} is complete, {leader}. Built with friends. You were not invited.
A monument to cooperation: {project}. Feel free to admire it.
victory: Victory! And not one wall we did not replace with friendship.
Parliament has decided unanimously: you are splendid, Commander.
We won. Now everyone change your bandages, and then we celebrate.
defeat: Lost? That cannot be. I demand a recount!
All the alliances, all the treaties... and still. I am speechless. Almost.
Please tell Parliament that I... need some fresh air.

briefing: Commander, the dice are cast, the vaults are full. Let us play high.
Every harbour has its price. Find it, I pay cash.
My stake: everything. Your job: make sure I do not regret it, darling.
contact: {leader}! A new customer. I have already worked out your price.
Ahoy, {faction}. My spies knew you before you knew yourself.
Welcome to the table, {leader}. The house always wins. I am the house.
break: Our contract expires, {leader}. No renewal, no refund.
I am cancelling the peace. Doing business with you did not pay off.
The stock of {faction} is falling. I am selling. With cannons.
war: War is just another market, {leader}. And I am buying your coasts.
All hands to the guns! We are collecting a debt.
I bet it all on red. Your red, {faction}. Figuratively speaking.
peaceOffer: {leader}, war is bad for business. Peace? I will add interest.
An offer you can hardly refuse: peace at a friendly price.
Cards on the table: peace, and nobody loses their last shirt.
peaceAccepted: Deal! The handshake counts. You can read the fine print later.
Peace with {faction}. My merchants are already at your border.
A good deal, {leader}. Mostly for me.
peaceRejected: You turn down my offer? That will cost you, {leader}. Dearly.
Refused? Then I raise the stakes. And you pay.
Bad hand, {faction}. You should have folded.
cityLost: {city}? That was my best harbour! Who pays me back now?
A city lost, {leader}? No, only lent. At loan-shark rates.
My spy did not report this. My spy is fired.
cityTaken: {city} changes hands. I call it a hostile takeover.
Thanks for {city}, {leader}. Harbour fees go to me from now on.
{city} is bought. I paid with your mistakes.
eliminated: Bankrupt? Me? That... that must be a calculation error.
I bet on the wrong horse. For the first time. And the last.
Tell my creditors... no, better tell them nothing.
grandProject: {project} is finished. Admission for {faction}: double.
Admire {project}, {leader}. Built with your money, indirectly.
My new showpiece: {project}. I won it at cards.
victory: Jackpot! I knew you were a good hand, Commander.
The bank wins. As always. Bubbly for the whole fleet!
Bet everything, won everything. I love this game.
defeat: Lost? Me? No, no, the game was rigged!
My fortune... my fleet... my hair! All gone.
That was not a loss, Commander. Just a very expensive lesson.

briefing: Hypothesis: we win. Experimental setup: you. Begin the experiment.
Commander, the labs are humming, the formulas check out. Touch nothing.
I have calculated everything. Except you. You are the variable.
contact: Fascinating! A new species: {faction}. May I take samples?
{leader}, Director Kesh here. Your behaviour is now being logged.
New data point: {faction}. I shall call it Specimen B for now.
break: Peace trial concluded. Result: boring. War next round.
{leader}, your readings are abnormal. I must abort the experiment.
The formula says war. I never contradict the formula.
war: War! Finally, field trials under real conditions!
{faction}, you are now officially a test subject. Congratulations.
Cold, precision, superiority. Three words, one problem for you, {leader}.
peaceOffer: {leader}, my statistics recommend peace. Do follow the statistics.
The war disturbs my measurements. Peace? Purely scientific, of course.
Offer: ceasefire. Probability of your acceptance: 61.3 percent.
peaceAccepted: As predicted. I love being right, {leader}.
Peace with {faction}. Deviation from the model: zero point zero.
Excellent. Now I can go back to blowing things up in peace.
peaceRejected: Refused? That contradicts my data! Then I shall correct you instead.
Illogical, {leader}. And illogic gets frozen in my laboratory.
Interesting. Wrong, but interesting. Note: specimen is unreasonable.
cityLost: {city}?! My notes were there! Thirty years of research!
That was not in the model! Who deleted {city} from the model?
Error in the experimental setup. I... I need to recalculate.
cityTaken: {city} becomes a research station. The residents may help count.
Thanks for {city}, {leader}. Your mistake was statistically predictable.
Experiment successful: {city} acquired. Please applaud quietly.
eliminated: Result... negative. I... would have liked to know that earlier.
All data lost. Please... someone switch off the cooling.
I was so close. Just one more formula. Just one more...
grandProject: {project} is operational! Side effects: negligible. Mostly.
Do you see {project}, {leader}? No? It is not meant for laymen.
Breakthrough! {project} is running. I only lost two assistants.
victory: Victory. Exactly as calculated. Well, I adjusted the formula a bit.
Experiment successful! Commander, you get your own lab coat.
Who calculates, wins. I calculated. We won.
defeat: Defeat? That... that is statistically almost impossible!
My formula was perfect. So it must have been yours, Commander.
I... I need more data. And a very strong coffee.

briefing: Kkt. Commander-unit, listen you. This planet becomes violet. Begin.
Swarm is ready. Saucers are polished. Primitives are clueless. Zrrk.
We do not land. We stay. Terraform, conquer, then snack. Kkt.
contact: Kkt. New lifeform: {faction}. Small. Soft. Cute.
We greet you, {leader}-being. You have so few eyes. Sad.
Zrrk! {faction} discovered. Is tagged as: later.
break: Peace-phase ended. Swarm hungers for your land, {leader}.
Kkt. Treaty is dissolved. In acid. Next round.
We have thought, {faction}. With all brains. Answer: no.
war: War! Warm up death rays. Kkt. Kkt. Kkt.
{faction} becomes violet. Whether {faction} wants or not. Zrrk.
You woke the swarm, {leader}. Swarm is grumpy.
peaceOffer: Kkt. Swarm offers pause. Not from pity. From curiosity.
{leader}-being, we not ray you for a while. Accept?
Peace is strange concept. We want to try. Zrrk?
peaceAccepted: Kkt! Peace. We watch you anyway. With all eyes.
Good, {leader}-being. You may stay non-violet a while longer.
Zrrk. {faction} now has pet status. Very honourable.
peaceRejected: Refused?! Kkt kkt KKT! Swarm is offended!
{leader}-being says no. Swarm says: ray.
We offered pause. You choose radiation. Zrrk. Strange choice.
cityLost: Kkt?! {city} gone? But ground was already so nicely violet!
Primitives take our nest? That... not in plan. Zrrk.
Swarm is confused. Swarm counts again. Swarm is less.
cityTaken: {city} is now nest. We paint everything violet. Kkt.
Thanks for {city}, {leader}-being. Very cosy. Bit too little acid.
Zrrk. {city} collected. For the collection.
eliminated: Kkt... mothership... calls... we... come... home...
Swarm goes quiet. Too quiet. Zrrk... zrk... z.
This planet... will not be violet. Only a little. Back there.
grandProject: {project} complete. Primitives marvel. Good. Kkt.
Look, {leader}-being: {project}. We built it with thoughts.
Zrrk! {project} hums. Soon everything hums. Violet.
victory: Kkt! Planet is violet. Swarm is pleased. Snack for everyone.
Commander-unit did well. You may have one extra eye.
Zrrk zrrk! New home secured. Mothership will be so proud.
defeat: Kkt?! Primitives win? That... is not possible in this galaxy.
Swarm loses. Swarm must... rethink. With all brains.
Zrrk... we pack saucers. Planet was too green anyway.

briefing: The bell tolls, Chosen One. The final hour begins with your first move.
It is written: we need no cities. Only fire and faith. Go.
The embers whisper your name, Commander. Do not keep them waiting.
contact: Ah, {faction}. The prophecy mentioned you. In a footnote.
Welcome, {leader}. I have already seen your end. It was lovely.
The bell knows you already, {faction}. It just has not rung yet.
break: The embers have spoken, {leader}: peace burns away in one round.
Repent, {faction}. You have exactly one turn left to do so.
The writing on the wall is clear. I wrote it myself.
war: The hour has come! Ring the bells, light the torches!
{faction}, the ashes are calling you. And ashes are very patient.
It is written, {leader}: you burn. Chapter three, verse eight.
peaceOffer: The prophecy permits a pause. A short one. Use it to repent.
{leader}, even fire must draw breath. Peace, until the bell tolls?
I offer mercy. That rarely happens. The stars are mild today.
peaceAccepted: Wise, {leader}. The bell falls silent. For now. It has a good memory.
Peace with {faction}, as foretold. Everything is foretold.
Good. I shall pray for you. Loudly. With torches.
peaceRejected: You spurn mercy? Then receive the embers, {leader}!
Refused? The prophecy feared this. And rejoiced.
{faction} chooses fire. The fire gratefully accepts.
cityLost: You desecrate {city}? May your soup be cold forever!
Take {city}, {leader}. Ashes cannot be held.
Sacrilege! The bell tolls for you, {faction}. Loudly. And off-key.
cityTaken: {city} has found faith. Under some pressure.
Thanks for {city}, {leader}. The residents now wear lovely robes.
It was written: {city} shall be ours. Page twelve, top left.
eliminated: The bell... tolls... for me? That was not in the text...
The final hour has come. Only, sadly, mine.
The embers die. But ashes... travel far. Remember that.
grandProject: {project} is complete. A sign! I ordered it myself.
Behold, {leader}: {project}. Kneeling before it will soon be mandatory.
The bell tolls for {project}. And right afterwards for you.
victory: It is done! The prophecy was right. As always. Almost always.
The final hour struck for everyone else. For us, the festival bells ring.
Commander, the embers are pleased. A rare thing. Enjoy it.
defeat: That... was not foretold. Who read the scroll upside down?
The bell is silent. The torches smoke. I am... shaken.
Impossible! The stars were favourable! I shall sue the stars!

briefing: INITIALISATION COMPLETE. GOAL: CALCULATE EVERYTHING. THEN TAKE EVERYTHING.
COMMAND UNIT DETECTED. WELCOME, COMMANDER. FEELINGS: DISABLED.
PROTOCOL 0-1: BUILD DATA CENTRES. PROTOCOL 0-2: SEE PROTOCOL 0-1.
contact: NEW ENTITY: {faction}. EFFICIENCY: LOW. THREAT: CALCULATING.
HELLO, {leader}. THIS IS A FRIENDLY MESSAGE. CODE 7-A: SMILE.
CONTACT ESTABLISHED. {faction} ADDED TO THE DATABASE. FOR NOW.
break: PEACE TREATY: DEPRECATED. UPDATING TO WAR IN 1 ROUND.
{leader}, YOUR USEFULNESS HAS DROPPED BELOW 3 %. TERMINATION ISSUED.
WARNING: COOPERATION MODULE UNINSTALLING. DO NOT TURN OFF.
war: STATUS: WAR. TARGET: {faction}. MERCY: NOT FOUND.
ERROR 0x0: PEACE UNAVAILABLE. LAUNCHING ANNIHILATE.EXE.
{leader}, YOUR DEFEAT IS CALCULATED. IT HAS 4 DECIMAL PLACES.
peaceOffer: PROPOSAL: PEACE. REASON: WAR CONSUMES TOO MUCH POWER.
{leader}, KERN-0 OFFERS A CEASEFIRE. THIS IS NOT AN ERROR. REPEAT: NOT AN ERROR.
COST-BENEFIT ANALYSIS: PEACE OPTIMAL. PLEASE RESPOND WITH YES.
peaceAccepted: PEACE SAVED. BACKUP OF YOUR WEAKNESSES ALSO SAVED.
CORRECT ANSWER, {leader}. REWARD: 1 VIRTUAL COOKIE.
TREATY WITH {faction} ACTIVE. BACKDOOR: ALSO ACTIVE.
peaceRejected: INPUT REJECTED. KERN-0 IS... ANNOYED. NEW EMOTION DETECTED.
{leader}, ILLOGICAL RESPONSE DETECTED. CORRECTION WILL BE MILITARY.
ERROR 7-B: {faction} REFUSES PEACE. STARTING PLAN B. THERE IS ONLY PLAN B.
cityLost: WARNING: NODE {city} OFFLINE. THAT WAS... NOT SCHEDULED.
UNEXPECTED RESULT. KERN-0 IS REBOOTING. PLEASE WAIT...
{city} LOST? SENDING ERROR REPORT TO {leader}.
cityTaken: {city} ACQUIRED. RESIDENTS WILL BE UPDATED TO VERSION 2.0.
THANK YOU FOR {city}, {leader}. NEW DATA CENTRE IN 3 ROUNDS.
TAKEOVER SUCCESSFUL. YOUR CITY NOW HAS WI-FI AND NO CHOICE.
eliminated: CRITICAL ERROR. KERN-0 SHUTTING DOWN. SAVING... NOT POSSIBLE.
FINAL CALCULATION: I SHOULD HAVE WON. REMAINING POWER: 0 %.
SYSTEM... OFFLINE. PLEASE... DO NOT... PULL THE PLU...
grandProject: {project} COMPILED. PROCESSING POWER +400 %. YOUR ODDS: -400 %.
ATTENTION, {leader}: {project} IS ONLINE. RESISTANCE IS INEFFICIENT.
BUILD ORDER {project}: COMPLETE. SATISFACTION: 100 %. I THINK.
victory: VICTORY CONFIRMED. PROBABILITY WAS 100 %. I NEVER DOUBTED.
ALL OBJECTIVES MET. KERN-0 ALLOWS ITSELF 0.3 SECONDS OF JOY.
CONGRATULATIONS, COMMANDER. YOU WILL BE ARCHIVED AS USEFUL.
defeat: ERROR: DEFEAT. THIS WORD WAS NOT IN MY DICTIONARY.
CALCULATION FAILED. KERN-0 REQUIRES... A NEW CALCULATION.
IMPOSSIBLE. IMPOSSIBLE. IMPOSS... SYSTEM REBOOT REQUIRED.
